description.name: Entry
description.text: Restores HP (55), grants [Regenga] and [Instant Cast 1] to all allies, grants [Awoken Devotion] and [Pure Lotus Mode] to the user

description.name: Awoken Devotion
description.text: White Magic and Support abilities do not consume uses, cast speed x?/?/?/?/? for White Magic and Support abilities at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, chases White Magic and Support abilities with [Quick Cast 1] and restores HP (25) to all allies

description.name: Pure Lotus Mode
description.text: Causes [Conditional Imperil 10% (15s)] when another ally uses an ability that deals Fire, Ice, Lightning, Earth, Wind, Water, Holy, Dark or Poison damage, removed after triggering two times

description.name: Conditional Imperil 10% (15s)
description.text: Causes [Imperil Fire 10% (15s)], [Imperil Ice 10% (15s)], [Imperil Lightning 10% (15s)], [Imperil Earth 10% (15s)], [Imperil Wind 10% (15s)], [Imperil Water 10% (15s)], [Imperil Holy 10% (15s)], [Imperil Dark 10% (15s)] or [Imperil Poison 10% (15s)] based on the element of the triggering abilitiy
